newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Shafranik appointed head of Russia's Tyumen Oil.
newsitem.headline: Shafranik appointed head of Russia's Tyumen Oil.

text.p: Russia's former energy minister Yuri Shafranik has been appointed chairman of the board of Russian oil company AO Tyumenskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.
Tyumen is one of a dozen vertically integrated oil companies set up in Russian over the last few years. Its main operating company is AO Nizhnevartovskneftegaz NZGZ.RTS.
Shafranik replaces Nizhnevartovskneftegaz chief executive Viktor Pali as head of Tyumen.

Shafranik was replaced as energy minister last week by Pyotr Rodionov, a senior executive at Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom. He is to become an adviser to Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on energy issues.
